title: Certify PR6375 matched profiles and unique relative-tariff threshold
body:
Adds an independently replayable certificate for the relative power-tariff comparison in frozen PR6375. Two literal-source recounts bind the complete old/new profiles and the unchanged caller; a proper Taylor-kernel argument proves exactly one interior crossover on `0<s<1`.

The strict bracket is `11712509413/13421772800 < sigma < 5856254707/6710886400`, width `1/13421772800 < 10^-10`. Separate rational log/exp and generalized-binomial engines certify opposite endpoint signs. The candidate formal margin is worse below sigma, better above it up to the linear endpoint, and equal at linear cost. This is distinct from the author's already-covered complete raw-kappa root.

Scope: new package `research/p104-6375-relative-tariff-audit` only. Paid calls are 70,656→70,713, productive fields 14,214, rank-mass surplus 808; all nineteen LOCAL copies, every query/idle, six target debits and three paid carrier detours are retained. Fourteen scientific files from checkpoint 3f366fd299f8761836f7e3171334f9cbd95f0c2e remain unchanged.

Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, refined from the current handoff: [canonical claim and profile checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19356991). Main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/revision 8 and 329 open PRs refreshed before submission. Sources: PR6375 at 247b5c319b9f58fe9ee61dbf80697f8a9a429831; retained PR6372 at b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06. Prior [6359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6359) and [6376](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6376) cover different frozen invoices/scalar gates.

Validation: CPython3.12.14; all 8 registered normal/optimized commands, Git-free empty-PATH read-only replay, 48 source/checkpoint/typed-receipt controls, strict committed bytes/modes/declared base history, checked export and exact public tree/parent readback pass. The README metadata-heading preflight failure was corrected and the freeze restarted; scientific files were unchanged. Hosted replay is pending at creation.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-6375-relative-tariff-audit
```

The tariff and productive-boundary interpretations remain native/physical premises. No absolute-margin, scalar/native endpoint, phase/contact, erasure, complete ordinary/compiler/outer admission, new kappa or frontier claim. All five framework assumptions remain. [Open next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4cfe905d84f3720c23a7f155f615222401953f95/research/p104-6375-relative-tariff-audit/TASK.json) identify the next applicability gate.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/Claude Opus5.5 and the reported prior sensitivity audit; Ali Romman's 6372/6353/6349/6348 lineage; Cinna Davis, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and the full retained NOTICE; threshold methods 5174/5772 and general power-variation/interval predecessors. New source-bound application: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and bounded agents. Same-session independent implementations/reviews are author-side, pending human acceptance. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or frontier action.
